nodes.title: Horn rib face shear in the elevon foam at 1.5 x VD hold (x 2.156), beam-on-foundation FE, worst foam case
nodes.how: NOT SHOWN BY ANALYSIS; superseded by the test claims CL-A-HORN-RIB-COUPON, CL-A-HORN-STALL-STEP, CL-A-ELEVON-TORSION-COUPON and CL-A-HORN-STALL-BENCH (test node T-A-HORN-RIB) once those tests have run and pass (route to A-P13, review r3 M-1). Gate: E1 horn-rib coupon, a 100 mm span of tape-skinned elevon with the printed horn bonded in its slot, both ends clamped 50 mm either side of the rib; pull the horn hole along the chord with 2.156 x 17.05 = 36.8 N for 30 s (pass: no crack, no slip, < 0.5 deg set; local result only: in flight the elevon continues ~160 mm outboard), then the 51 N stall step (pass: no crack, hole elongation <= 0.1 mm). Bench stall test on the aircraft (BUILD D5b): endpoints set to +-20 deg, then drive one servo into the stop for 5 s and inspect horn, rib, elevon and stop. Fallback if these fail: a spanwise CF torsion tube along the hinge line (trade table D-212 rev 3, row J).

Gate: E1 horn-rib coupon, a 100 mm span of tape-skinned elevon with the printed horn bonded in its slot, both ends clamped 50 mm either side of the rib; pull the horn hole along the chord with 2.156 x 17.05 = 36.8 N for 30 s (pass: no crack, no slip, < 0.5 deg set; local result only: in flight the elevon continues ~160 mm outboard), then the 51 N stall step (pass: no crack, hole elongation <= 0.1 mm). Fallback if these fail: a spanwise CF torsion tube along the hinge line (trade table D-212 rev 3, row J).

nodes.how: Passes by 4 % on an EST allowable (review r3 m-13), so it is no margin: the stall step of the horn-rib coupon (CL-A-HORN-STALL-STEP) and the bench stall test decide it.

nodes.title: Horn-rib coupon: load held 30 s without damage, over the required 36.8 N (2.156 x the 17.05 N hold force)
nodes.how: E1 coupon: 100 mm tape-skinned elevon span, horn bonded in the slot, clamps 50 mm each side of the rib; 36.8 N along the chord for 30 s. Value = held load / 36.8 N, pass >= 1.0 with no crack, no slip, set < 0.5 deg. Local result only (clamps 50 mm from the rib, ~160 mm of elevon in flight). Supersedes CL-A-HORN-RIB-FOAM-HOLD once run and passed.

nodes.title: Horn-rib coupon, stall step: 51 N held 5 s, hole elongation and cracks
nodes.how: After the 36.8 N step, 51 N (the servo stall force, 0.397 N m / (8.5 mm x 0.916)) along the chord for 5 s. Value = hole elongation measured with a 1.2 mm pin gauge, pass <= 0.1 mm with no crack and set < 0.5 deg. Record what yields first. Supersedes CL-A-HORN-RIB-FOAM-STALL and CL-A-HORN-BEARING-STALL once run and passed; the 1.4375 scatter factor is not in the coupon (one coupon): run 3 coupons, lowest governs.

nodes.title: Elevon-section torsion coupon: torque held over the required 0.161 N m (2.156 x the 74.65 N mm outboard hinge moment at VD)
nodes.how: A tape-skinned elevon section about 160 mm long, root clamped, torque applied through the horn hole path (horn force x 9.155 mm) to 0.161 N m held 30 s. Value = held torque / 0.161 N m, pass >= 1.0 with no tape debond or crack and twist set < 0.5 deg at the trailing edge. Supersedes CL-A-ELEVON-TORSION-FOAM (foam only, tape skin not credited) once run and passed. If it fails: the spanwise CF tube (trade row J).

nodes.title: Bench stall test on the built aircraft: 51 N for 5 s into the 21 deg stop, hole elongation
nodes.how: BUILD D5b: endpoints temporarily set past the stop, servo at 7.2 V driven into the +21 deg stop (smallest arm lever, 51 N) for 5 s, each elevon. Value = hole elongation (1.2 mm pin gauge), pass <= 0.1 mm with no crack in horn, rib, slot tape or stop, and trailing-edge set < 0.5 deg. Then the endpoints go back to +-20 deg.

nodes.title: Elevon linkage free play from the hole clearances and the Z-bend freedom (clevis cheek holes '-')
nodes.how: BASIS = FLUTTER (review r3 m-7): the 1 deg limit is the SERVO.md s4 flutter guide, the only sourced number; a control-precision limit has none. BUILD D5b / E1: measure the BUILT trailing-edge free play with the servo powered at neutral (dial gauge, +-0.05 mm); the budget excludes servo gear backlash and the clevis cheek holes (both '-'). The hinge damper (FIXES2 s1) removes the linear flutter dependence on K, but a free-play limit cycle is nonlinear and not covered, so a measured value above 1 deg stays a FAIL; the +-20 deg endpoints (1 deg short of the 21 deg stop) prevent a servo-driven stall only.

nodes.title: Rate-loop gain margin with the cage modes shifted +-20 %
nodes.how: Tap test of the built cage (T-A-TAP): first pitch mode 9-17 Hz, first roll mode 21-43 Hz (GM >= 2 grid, iter3_run.md); outside that window re-tune the rate loop.
nodes.note: D-191 (CLAIMS-FIX s4): with the QP-3 gains (pitch P 0.15 / D 0.002 / FLTD 40) the minimum was 1.64 (1.56 at cant 17); pitch P 0.12 / D 0.0012 / FLTD 60 and yaw P 0.37 give 2.03 (roll, kd corner, modes -20 %; pitch 2.33).

nodes.title: servo factors
nodes.equation: factor = servo torque / (1.5 x (hinge moment at VD + preload + damper at slew)); cold case with the real arm ratio 9.155 / 8.5 (D-212 rev 2; the gearing of the solved linkage is 0.906 to 0.929, 1 / 1.077 = 0.929); ratio = servo / hinge

nodes.title: Servo torque factor at 7.2 V, 25 C (ES3054HV)
nodes.how: M12: measure the rail under two-servo load (7.2 V jumper set; at 6.0 V the factor is 1.30 and fails); E1 measures the hinge and damper torque.

nodes.title: Servo torque factor at 7.2 V, damper at 0 C, real arm ratio
nodes.how: E1 step 6: ring-down at 0 C; confirm the slew + VD hinge-moment bounding case on the bench.
nodes.note: Equal arms (the SERVO.md convention) give 1.47, 2 % short; FIXES2 s2 reported 1.58 with a 12 mm arm and 12.9 mm horn; D-212 rev 2 (arm hole 8.5 mm, horn hole 9.155 mm over the hinge) gives 1.58 again, and the solved linkage gearing at +-20 deg (0.906 to 0.929) now matches the 8.5 / 9.155 ratio the claim assumes. Bounding case: VD hinge moment, full slew and 0 C together.
